resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA listing gives 34.30150, -110.71322 and the NHLR gives 34.30139, -110.71361, a few tens of metres apart. The NHLR values are used, matching the brief.

notes_for_editor: Construction and registration facts agree across the NHLR entry, the Forest Service post and the FFLA listing. Access is unknown: the brief says 'unknown' and no source I read says whether the public may enter the cab, so access is omitted. No staffing or fire history found in two searches. The NHLR text has a typo ('Nationa Forest') and the campground page says 'lighting storms'; quotes keep the source spelling. A Wikimedia Commons photo of the tower appeared in search (File:Gentry Fire Lookout Tower in Apache-Sitgreaves National Forests (cropped).jpg) but its licence was not read, so no photo entry was added.
